$comment: Every package whose native iOS code is linked into the mapper app, reviewed (ADR 0010, 'Native dependencies'). The encoder check covers only the capture module, so a package that writes images, snapshots views or writes to the Photos library is refused unless ADR 0010 is amended. test/native-dependencies.test.ts fails when autolinking finds a package that isn't listed here, finds a refused one, or no longer finds a listed one.

allowed.capture-native: This app's capture module (modules/capture-native): its image paths are covered by the encoder check
allowed.@expo/dom-webview: The WKWebView behind the map's DOM component
allowed.@expo/ui: SwiftUI components for Expo Router's native tabs; no image writing
allowed.@react-native-masked-view/masked-view: Masked views for Expo Router's headers
allowed.expo-asset: Bundled assets (fonts, the map's DOM component)
allowed.expo-constants: App config and the dev server's host
allowed.expo-device: The device model and OS on the Capture screen
allowed.expo-file-system: Files under the app's container; writes no images itself
allowed.expo-keep-awake: Keeps the screen on in development
allowed.expo-symbols: SF Symbols in the tab bar
allowed.react-native-gesture-handler: Gestures, a peer of Expo Router
allowed.react-native-reanimated: Animations, a peer of Expo Router
allowed.react-native-svg: The floor-plan drawing. Its toDataURL renders only its own SVG drawing, never another view; the camera view is never inside an SVG

refused.expo-camera: A second camera path, and it writes photos and video
refused.react-native-vision-camera: A second camera path, and it writes photos and video
refused.expo-image-picker: Writes photo and video copies, and opens the camera
refused.expo-print: Renders views and HTML to files
refused.expo-sharing: Sends files out of the app
